Maya B. (Sales): Quick handoff for AcmeHealth private deploy. Key points: VPC private, HIPAA scope, SAML SSO, requesting Dedicated pool for prod. Trial start target 2025-04-04. During a recent internal 80QPS synthetic run they saw p95 spikes ~1.2s. CFO is worried about cost delta for prod vs staging. Please confirm onboarding checklist and owners.

Sarah L. (CS): Thanks Maya. I'll lead onboarding. Questions: do they need HSM or is cloud KMS acceptable? Who's the SAML IdP POC? Also need the full prompt set and expected SLOs.

Maya B. (Sales): KMS is fine. IdP POC is it-team@acme.co (they're CC'd on the email). Prompt set uploaded here: https://s3.company/acme/evals/promptset_v2.json. Target SLOs: p50 <250ms, p95 <600ms at sustained 40 QPS. They want a cost comparison q4f16 vs fp16.

Alex R. (Support): I'll own SSO/SCIM integration once we have metadata. Opening a support ticket now.

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-4321 created: "AcmeHealth private deploy onboarding: SSO, dedicated pool, perf tuning" - https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4321

John P. (Eng): Infra notes: model is 7B, using q4f16 (~12GB resident). To hit 40 QPS with ~2k tokens we need autoscale + batching. Proposed steps:
1) Provision staging dedicated pool (f1 instances), min 2 replicas.
2) Run load test: ab-runner --model gpt-7b-q4f16 --seq 2048 --qps 40 --concurrency 8
3) Enable prefix/KV caching and min_batch=4.
I'll spin up eng ticket for private-deploy template and network checklist.

Sarah L. (CS): Timeline suggestion: staging up by 2025-03-28, SSO demo 2025-04-02, prod trial kickoff 2025-04-04. I will handle customer comms and invite.

Maya B. (Sales): Please note cert rotation window and any network peering requirements. Also they asked for explicit GPU cost % savings for q4f16 vs fp16 in both staging and prod profiles.

John P. (Eng): Quick cost pointer: q4f16 typically cuts GPU memory and cost ~25-35% but depends on latency target and effective batch size. I'll upload recommended quant profiles and perf numbers to CS-4321.

Sarah L. (CS): Owners (adding to ticket): Sarah L. (CS) - onboarding lead; John P. (Eng) - private deploy & perf; Alex R. (Support) - SSO/SCIM; Maya B. (Sales) - commercial owner. Next steps: attach prompt set to shared drive, customer to complete security questionnaire, schedule kick-off invite.

Alex R. (Support): Added IdP metadata placeholder to CS-4321. Please attach live metadata when available.

Maya B. (Sales): Will send IdP metadata and SCIM creds by EOD tomorrow.

Sarah L. (CS): I'll attach latency traces and sample runs to the ticket for eng to review.

John P. (Eng): If we observe longer sequences in production we may need to bump replicas or enable KV offload. I'll monitor results after staging load tests.

Sarah L. (CS): Scheduling 30m kickoff 2025-03-29. I'll invite owners and the customer POC.

Maya B. (Sales): Thanks all. Please flag any blockers on CS-4321.

Sarah L. (CS): Will update ticket with post-kickoff notes. Closing thread for now.
